defs.def: feeling or showing happiness and enthusiasm 激动的；兴奋的

ex.s: When Nick runs ahead, I hear him barking excitedly.
ex.t: 当尼克跑在前面时，我听到他兴奋地吠叫。

ex.s: It's a joy for him to see the kids get excited when they learn to sound out words.
ex.t: 最重要的是，故事具有变革的力量，让我们能够以一种不同于独自面对世界的方式来看待这个世界。

ex.s: It helped that in the end I was accepted into one of the other programmes I was also excited about.
ex.t: 好在最后我被另一个我也同样期待的项目录取了。

ex.s: Sherman Cymru is excited to present a packed programme of the very best theatre, dance, family shows and music from Wales and the rest of the world.
ex.t: Sherman Cymru很高兴呈献一套密集的节目，囊括来自威尔士及世界各地最优秀的戏剧、舞蹈、家庭秀和音乐。

ex.s: Tom is proud of his design and excited to be selling the Fun Bottle on his website and in stores but this 15-year-old is most proud of the opportunities that Fun Bottle presents to others.
ex.t: Tom对他的设计感到自豪，也很兴奋能在他的网站和商店销售Fun Bottle，但这位15岁少年最引以为豪的是Fun Bottle为他人带来的机会。

ex.s: "I don't know where it will lead, but I'm excited I'm on this pursuit."
ex.t: "我不知道这将通向何方但我很高兴我正在追求这个目标。"

ex.s: When "Rise of the Planet of the Apes" was first shown to the public last month, a group of excited animal activists gathered on Hollywood Boulevard.
ex.t: 上月《猩球崛起》首次公映时，一群兴奋的动物保护人士聚集在好莱坞大道。

ex.s: But all of today's excited discussion about these possibilities presupposes the fact that we will be able to build these systems.
ex.t: 但今天关于这些可能性的所有兴奋讨论，都预设了我们将能够建造这些系统这一事实。

ex.s: It was a tradition for the school's old team to play against the（4）     team at the end of spring practice． The old team had no coach， and they didn't even practice to（5）     the game． Being the coach of the new team， I was excited because I knew we were going to win， but to my disappointment we were defeated． I couldn't （6）     I had got into such a situation． Thinking hard about it， I came to（7）     that my team might not be the number one team in Georgia， but they were（8）     me． I had to change my （9）     about their ability and potential．
ex.t: 学校的元老队在春季训练结束时与（4）______队比赛是一个传统。元老队没有教练，他们甚至不为（5）______比赛而练习。作为新队的教练，我很兴奋，因为我知道我们会赢，但令我失望的是我们被打败了。我无法（6）______相信我会陷入这样的境地。仔细思考后，我（7）______意识到我的队可能不是佐治亚州第一名，但他们信任（8）______我。我必须改变我对他们能力和潜力的（9）______看法。

ex.s: The museum was free． We entered， excited． A group of people sitting in the hall stopped talking and stared at us．
ex.t: 博物馆免费。我们兴奋地走进去。大厅里坐着的一群人停下交谈，盯着我们看。

ex.s: In English, the word gung-ho is an adjective that means extremely excited about doing something.
ex.t: 美国海军陆战队上校埃文斯·卡尔森在中国时观察了这些合作社。

ex.s: Yet instead of being discouraged by my   54   progress, I was excited.
ex.t: 然而，我没有因为进展____而气馁，反而很兴奋。

ex.s: She says these activities at bedtime can get kids all excited and make it hard for them to calm down and sleep.
ex.t: 她说这些睡前活动会让孩子兴奋起来，使他们很难平静下来入睡。

ex.s: Exercise energizes you, so it is more difficult to relax and have a peaceful sleep when you are very excited.
ex.t: 运动会让你精力充沛，所以当你非常兴奋时，更难放松并获得安宁的睡眠。

ex.s: People were excited – the zoo is the only place in the country where it is possible to see pandas.
ex.t: 人们很兴奋——动物园是这个国家唯一能看到熊猫的地方。

ex.s: And of course, the main reason why they were so excited is that pandas are just so cute!
ex.t: 当然，他们之所以如此兴奋，最主要的原因还是熊猫实在太可爱了！

ex.s: I can't tell you how excited I am about going to China!
ex.t: 我简直没法告诉你我对于要去中国有多兴奋！

ex.s: The children must have been very excited as they opened it.
ex.t: 打开它的时候，孩子们一定非常兴奋。

defs.def: nervous or upset and unable to relax 受刺激的；紧张不安的
feeling sexual desire 性兴奋的
